items.title: Floor scrolled line in command tracking
fix various nls issues
items.body:
@rebornix summary of changes:
* use capital casing in more places
* do not add category as part of the label, add it explicitly when registering the action
* ensure that the alias and the label are the same
* use `nls.localize` for strings that need to be localized
* fix one bad label `Layout: ${layoutInfo}`
* Current Keyboard Layout => Keyboard Layout

I was not sure about the tooltip, so I removed it.

items.title: Potential workaround for electron 4 eating mouse events in webviews
items.body:
For #75090

This PR attempts to workaround the root cause of this issue by broadcasting synthetic mouse move and mouseup events from the webview back to the main window

items.title: Suppress MsgBox when Wizard is running in silent mode
items.body:
Fixes https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/75281

I have been able to reproduce the issue with both system and user installers of last stable version (1.35.1).

I have been testing building the setup binary with the fix and the bug is fixed. Following the steps in the issue with this fixes results with exit code 1 with no message boxes or dialogs (as expected, because other installation for other arch is installed).
